items.statement: When manufacturing a combination product that includes a drug constituent part other than a medical gas, comply with the US drug CGMP regulations for drugs and finished pharmaceuticals.
items.quote: The current good manufacturing practice requirements in parts 210 and 211 of this chapter apply to a combination product that includes a drug constituent part other than a medical gas;
items.condition: combination product with non-gas drug constituent part

items.statement: When manufacturing a combination product that includes a device constituent part, comply with the US device quality management system regulation (QMSR) CGMP requirements.
items.quote: The current good manufacturing practice requirements in part 820 of this chapter apply to a combination product that includes a device constituent part;
items.condition: combination product with device constituent part

items.statement: When manufacturing a combination product that includes a biological product constituent part, comply with the CGMP requirements (including standards) of the US biological product regulations that would apply to that constituent part if it were not part of a combination product.
items.quote: The current good manufacturing practice requirements among the requirements (including standards) for biological products in parts 600 through 680 of this chapter apply to a combination product that includes a biological product constituent part to which those requirements would apply if that constituent part were not part of a combination product;
items.condition: combination product with biological product constituent part

items.statement: When manufacturing a combination product that includes an HCT/P, comply with the US current good tissue practice requirements for HCT/Ps, including donor eligibility requirements.
items.quote: The current good tissue practice requirements including donor eligibility requirements for HCT/Ps in part 1271 of this chapter apply to a combination product that includes an HCT/P; and
items.condition: combination product that includes an HCT/P

items.statement: When manufacturing a combination product that includes a drug constituent part that is a medical gas, comply with the US medical gas CGMP requirements.
items.quote: The current good manufacturing practice requirements in part 213 of this chapter apply to a combination product that includes a drug constituent part that is a medical gas.
items.condition: combination product with medical gas drug constituent part

not_applicable.text: § 4.3 What current good manufacturing practice requirements apply to my combination product?
If you manufacture a combination product, the requirements listed

items.statement: For single-entity or co-packaged combination products, achieve compliance with all applicable CGMP requirements by designing and implementing a CGMP operating system that is demonstrated to comply either with the specifics of each applicable set of CGMP regulations as they apply to each constituent part, or with the streamlined approach requirements for combination products.
items.quote: Under this subpart, for single entity or co-packaged combination products, compliance with all applicable current good manufacturing practice requirements for the combination product shall be achieved through the design and implementation of a current good manufacturing practice operating system that is demonstrated to comply with:
items.condition: single-entity or co-packaged combination products

items.statement: For single-entity or co-packaged combination products where the streamlined approach is not used, demonstrate that the CGMP operating system complies with the specifics of each applicable set of CGMP regulations (drug, device, biological product, HCT/P, medical gas) as they apply to each constituent part in the combination product.
items.quote: The specifics of each set of current good manufacturing practice regulations listed under § 4.3 as they apply to each constituent part included in the combination product; or
items.condition: single-entity or co-packaged combination product; constituent-part approach

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that the ISO 13485 requirements for the general quality management system, management responsibility (with its subclauses) and provision of resources, and the QMSR quality management system requirement, are satisfied (using the ISO 9000 terms and definitions).
items.quote: General requirements and management responsibility. Clause 4.1, Clause 5 and its subclauses, Clause 6.1 of ISO 13485, and § 820.10 of this chapter;
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that the ISO 13485 design and development requirements (with their subclauses) are satisfied.
items.quote: Design and development. Clause 7.3 and its subclauses of ISO 13485.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that the organization has documented one or more processes for risk management in product realization.
items.quote: The organization shall document one or more processes for risk management in product realization.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that records of risk management activities are maintained.
items.quote: Records of risk management activities shall be maintained;
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that the ISO 13485 purchasing requirements (with their subclauses) are satisfied.
items.quote: Purchasing. Clause 7.4. and its subclauses of ISO 13485;
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that the ISO 13485 requirements for complaint handling, analysis of data and improvement (with its subclauses), and the QMSR requirement for complaint records, are satisfied.
items.quote: Analysis of data, improvement, and complaint handling. Clause 8.2.2 and § 820.35(a) of this chapter, Clause 8.4, and Clause 8.5. and its subclauses of ISO 13485;
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that the ISO 13485 installation activities requirements are satisfied.
items.quote: Installation activities. Clause 7.5.3 of ISO 13485; and
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the drug CGMP or medical gas CGMP requirements, as applicable (streamlined approach elected), also show that the ISO 13485 servicing activities requirements and the QMSR requirement for servicing records are satisfied.
items.quote: Servicing activities. Clause 7.5.4 of ISO 13485 and § 820.35(b) of this chapter.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + drug parts; system shown compliant with drug or medical gas CGMP

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on testing and approval or rejection of components, drug product containers and closures are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.84 of this chapter. Testing and approval or rejection of components, drug product containers, and closures.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on calculation of yield are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.103 of this chapter. Calculation of yield.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on tamper-evident packaging for over-the-counter (OTC) human drug products are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.132 of this chapter. Tamper-evident packaging requirements for over-the-counter (OTC) human drug products.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on expiration dating are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.137 of this chapter. Expiration dating.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on testing and release for distribution are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.165 of this chapter. Testing and release for distribution.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on stability testing are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.166 of this chapter. Stability testing.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on special testing requirements are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.167 of this chapter. Special testing requirements.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part other than a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR device requirements (streamlined approach elected), also show that the drug CGMP requirements on reserve samples are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 211.170 of this chapter. Reserve samples.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + non-gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part that is a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR (streamlined approach elected), also show that the medical gas CGMP requirements on testing and approval or rejection of components, containers and closures are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 213.84 of this chapter. Testing and approval or rejection of components, containers, and closures.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + medical gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part that is a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR (streamlined approach elected), also show that the medical gas CGMP requirements on medical gas containers and closures are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 213.94 of this chapter. Medical gas containers and closures.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + medical gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part that is a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR (streamlined approach elected), also show that the medical gas CGMP requirements on materials examination and usage criteria are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 213.122 of this chapter. Materials examination and usage criteria.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + medical gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part that is a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR (streamlined approach elected), also show that the medical gas CGMP requirements on testing and release for distribution are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 213.165 of this chapter. Testing and release for distribution.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + medical gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part that is a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR (streamlined approach elected), also show that the medical gas CGMP requirements on stability testing and expiration dating for medical gases marketed under applications submitted under section 505 or section 512 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 213.166 of this chapter. Stability testing and expiration dating for medical gases marketed under applications submitted under section 505 or section 512 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + medical gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part that is a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR (streamlined approach elected), also show that the medical gas CGMP requirements on returned medical gases are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 213.204 of this chapter. Returned medical gases.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + medical gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where a single-entity or co-packaged combination product has a device and a drug constituent part that is a medical gas and the CGMP operating system has been shown to comply with the QMSR (streamlined approach elected), also show that the medical gas CGMP requirements on salvaging of medical gases are satisfied.
items.quote: Section 213.208 of this chapter. Salvaging of medical gases.
items.condition: streamlined approach; device + medical gas drug parts; system shown compliant with QMSR

items.statement: Where the streamlined approach is elected for a single-entity or co-packaged combination product that includes a biological product constituent part, show that the CGMP operating system, in addition to complying with the other applicable manufacturing requirements, also implements and complies with all biological product manufacturing requirements that would apply to that biological product if it were not part of a combination product.
items.quote: In addition to being shown to comply with the other applicable manufacturing requirements listed under § 4.3, if the combination product includes a biological product constituent part, the current good manufacturing practice operating system must also be shown to implement and comply with all manufacturing requirements identified under § 4.3(c) that would apply to that biological product if that constituent part were not part of a combination product.
items.condition: streamlined approach; biological product constituent part

items.statement: Where the streamlined approach is elected for a single-entity or co-packaged combination product that includes an HCT/P, show that the CGMP operating system, in addition to complying with the other applicable CGMP requirements, also implements and complies with all current good tissue practice requirements that would apply to that HCT/P if it were not part of a combination product.
items.quote: In addition to being shown to comply with the other applicable current good manufacturing practice requirements listed under § 4.3, if the combination product includes an HCT/P, the current good manufacturing practice operating system must also be shown to implement and comply with all current good tissue practice requirements identified under § 4.3(d) that would apply to that HCT/P if it were not part of a combination product.
items.condition: streamlined approach; includes an HCT/P

items.statement: During any period when a constituent part of a co-packaged or single-entity combination product is manufactured at a facility separate from the other constituent part(s), demonstrate that the CGMP operating system for that constituent part at that facility complies with all CGMP requirements applicable to that type of constituent part.
items.quote: During any period in which the manufacture of a constituent part to be included in a co-packaged or single entity combination product occurs at a separate facility from the other constituent part(s) to be included in that single-entity or co-packaged combination product, the current good manufacturing practice operating system for that constituent part at that facility must be demonstrated to comply with all current good manufacturing practice requirements applicable to that type of constituent part.
items.condition: constituent part manufactured at a separate facility

items.statement: When two or more types of constituent parts of a single-entity or co-packaged combination product have arrived at the same facility, or their manufacture is proceeding at the same facility, the site may begin applying a CGMP operating system that complies with the streamlined approach requirements.
items.quote: When two or more types of constituent parts to be included in a single-entity or co-packaged combination product have arrived at the same facility, or the manufacture of these constituent parts is proceeding at the same facility, application of a current good manufacturing process operating system that complies with paragraph (b) of this section may begin.
items.condition: two or more constituent part types at the same facility
